title: USWNT vs. Spain: Listen Live on SiriusXM FC
summary: Tune in for live coverage of the U.S. Women's National Team's match against Spain.
body_markdown:
Listen live as the U.S. women’s national team takes on Spain as the world’s top two teams face off in the second of two friendly matches.

### How to Listen to the Live Radio Broadcast


Tune in to SiriusXM FC, available on satellite channel 188 and[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogUSLMatchesSiriusXMFC) .

**Location:** Subaru Park, Chester, PA

### About SiriusXM FC


The SiriusXM FC channel is dedicated entirely to the world’s most popular sport:[soccer](https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/soccer) .


It features an extensive schedule of live matches from the English Premier League,[Major League Soccer](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/live-mls-games) ,[UEFA Champions League](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/uefa-champions-league-final) , NWSL, USL Championship, and the FA Cup. Plus, hear a daily lineup of soccer talk programming hosted by former players and coaches, including Ray Hudson, Tony Meola, Rodney Marsh, and Eric Wynalda.[Learn more about SiriusXM FC here.](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/siriusxm-fc)
